title: security: rbac v2 enforce kms region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Asha Menon
description: Motivation: Customers in regulated regions need deterministic data residency for KMS-protected secrets. RBAC v2 introduced a KMS region pinning concept but previously only audited violations; this PR hardens the enforcement path and improves audit logging to make policy decisions traceable. Summary: 1) Add enforcement mode for RBAC v2 KMS region pinning (config: rbac.v2.kms_region_pin_mode = "audit|enforce"). 2) Tighten audit logs to capture the key residency decision, requester metadata, policy match, and fallback action. 3) Add migration script to detect existing resources with non-compliant KMS keys and surface remediation hints. 4) Add unit/integration tests and docs. Backwards compatibility: default remains "audit" until release window; feature gate and rollout plan included below. Checklist: - [x] Add enforcement runtime checks in rbac policy evaluator - [x] Extend audit adapter to include kms_key_region, policy_id, matching_rule - [x] Add infra TF module updates and a migration report script - [x] Add unit + integration tests (local and CI) - [x] Update docs and console UI messaging - [x] Add telemetry metrics for enforcement_rate and audit_rate - [x] Run compatibility tests against Dedicated and Private installers References: Linear ENG-1945, Security spec SEC-321, internal design doc: /docs/design/rbac-v2-kms-region-pinning.md
commits_summary: 5 commits: (1) rbac: add kms region pin enforcement and mode flag; (2) audit: include kms_key_region and policy context in events; (3) tests: add unit and integration tests for enforcement and migration; (4) infra: TF updates to document required key tagging; (5) docs: explain migration and rollout plan

Omar Haddad (review): Integration test flaked on CI (kms emulator timeout). Please add retry/backoff and make the test idempotent.
Author (Asha): Increased emulator timeouts, added retry logic to test harness, and re-ran CI. Marked the flaky test with [flaky] and added a follow-up Linear ticket ENG-2060.
Santiago Ruiz (approval): LGTM after the added metrics and docs updates; please squash and include a short migration guide in release notes.
ci_checks: integration tests (kms emulator): pass (rerun after fix)
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning (RBAC v2): Operators can now enable enforcement of KMS region residency rules. Default remains audit mode to avoid customer disruption. Audit logs now include kms_key_region and policy decision metadata to aid compliance investigations. Includes migration script to surface non-compliant keys and remediation guidance.
rollout_plan: Staged rollout: 1) Release behind feature flag with default 'audit' (vNext). 2) Run migration report for all tenants; notify customers with non-compliant keys. 3) After 30-day notice window, switch config for opted tenants to 'enforce' or schedule tenant-by-tenant enforcement. 4) Backport critical fixes to 1.x for Dedicated customers.
testing_notes: Unit tests cover policy evaluator branches. Integration tests run against kms-emulator in CI; added retry logic and increased timeouts. Manual validation performed on a Dedicated staging cluster and a Private installer image. Observability: enforcement_rate metric and audit events verified in trace and logs.
